step_rule: dm_control legacy step (Physics.legacy_step): set ctrl; mj_step2; mj_step x (n_sub_steps - 1); mj_step1. Observation and reward are read after it: position/velocity-stage quantities at the new state, acceleration-stage sensors (accelerometer, force, torque) from the forward pass of the last substep.

action.map: dm_control action_scale.Wrapper under NumPy 1.x promotion; per task (tasks[].action_map): float64: lo + (hi - lo) / 2 * f32(a + 1); float32 (suite tasks, ActionDTypeWrapper): all in float32

obs.dtype: float32 (flatten of the OrderedDict, cast once)

reset.rule: limited joints (id order) ~ U(range) (one numpy uniform each); then 200 physics steps (mj_step2, mj_step x 199, mj_step1; bitwise equal to 200 x (mj_step2, mj_step1)) from the un-forwarded randomized pose; time = 0; then an actuation-disabled mj_forward
